limitations: This summary is not a calibration artifact accepted by the engine; full assessments remain in the local ignored archive.

The labels have already been used for model selection and are not an untouched final test or population accuracy estimate.
All eight disagreements were false rejections on two policies. No false acceptance was observed in this bounded set; that does not establish a general false-acceptance rate.
